name: Latham Farms
summary: Latham Farms is a well-trafficked open-air shopping center on Troy-Schenectady Road serving the Capital Region with convenient access to national retailers and essential services. With a 4.3-star rating from over 3,400 reviews and extended daily hours, it has established itself as a reliable destination for everyday shopping needs in the Latham community.
demographics: Latham Farms attracts a diverse suburban demographic from the Capital Region of New York, including families and professionals from Latham, Albany, and surrounding communities. The trade area serves middle to upper-middle income households with median incomes ranging from $65,000 to $95,000, drawn by the convenience of big-box retailers and national chains. Primary shoppers include working parents aged 30-55 seeking one-stop shopping for household needs, groceries, and everyday essentials, with strong weekend traffic from families making routine shopping trips.
description: Latham Farms is a prominent open-air shopping destination located at 579 Troy-Schenectady Road in Latham, New York, serving the greater Capital Region with convenient access to major retailers and services. This well-established shopping center has become a go-to destination for residents of Albany County and beyond, offering a diverse mix of national chains and essential services in a convenient strip center format. The center's strategic location along the busy Troy-Schenectady corridor ensures high visibility and easy accessibility for shoppers throughout the region. With extended operating hours from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM, Latham Farms accommodates the busy schedules of working families and professionals who appreciate the convenience of multiple retailers in one location. The shopping center has earned a solid reputation in the community, reflected in its 4.3-star rating from over 3,400 reviews, demonstrating consistent customer satisfaction and its role as a reliable shopping destination for everyday needs.
